adhd.label: Step 1 · Part I, Ch. 1–3: Polishing Rusty Armor & Riding Out at Dawn (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Alonso Quixano reads chivalric romances until his imagination catches fire, names his skinny horse Rocinante, and gets dubiously knighted by a bewildered innkeeper.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Part I, Ch. 7–8: Recruiting Sancho Panza & Charging the Windmills
adhd.brief: Don Quixote recruits his practical neighbor Sancho Panza as squire and charges full tilt into thirty spinning windmills on the plain of Montiel.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Jumps to Part II: Sancho Governs His Island with Pure Common Sense
adhd.brief: When a duke makes Sancho Panza governor of a mock island as a prank, Sancho stuns everyone by solving complex court riddles with effortless peasant wisdom.
